verdict.rationale: Any service that holds customer data could fairly publish an AI-training opt-out or a no-training policy, so this privacy axis applies to a registrar. The evidence pack has no statement on AI training. WHOIS redaction is a related privacy feature about public registration records, not an AI-training control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
